title: Correct final force
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (1) must be F = Bkl/(3R).

title: Correct final work
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (2) must be W = (1/2)mv² - (2/3)kq.

title: Circuit analysis for current
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly combine the coil and rod resistances to find the total circuit current when S is closed.

title: Ampere force equilibrium
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply F = BIl to rod PQ and set it equal to the applied force for equilibrium in part (1).

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the work-energy theorem, relating the work done by the applied force, the Ampere force, and the kinetic energy change in part (2).

title: Relating charge to motion
description: Important Criteria: The student must link the given charge q to the induced EMF and the displacement of rod PQ using Faraday's law and I = q/Δt.

title: Induced EMF from coil
description: Important Criteria: The student must identify the EMF in the coil as k (the given flux change rate) for part (1).

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly assigns a positive sign to the work done by the Ampere force (it is negative/opposes motion).

title: Incorrect current division
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to recognize that the current from the coil splits equally between the two parallel rods MN and PQ when S is closed.
